messages.subject: example of SEM with time series?
parts:
Dear list,
 
Thank you very much for reading this email.
 
I have a data set of accelerated longitudinal design. There are 9 cohorts, measured by 12 items for 3 time points, 6 items for factor A, another 6 items for factor B. So the third measurement of the T cohort is also the first measurement of the T+1 cohort. After rearrange the data set, now there are 19 time points (with many missing values in each time point because they were actually not measured due to the accelerated longitudinal design).
 
So since there are two latent factors, I guess I can not avoid using SEM, but for 19 time points, can SEM still handle it? The google results showed some discussion about this, however, I have not been able to find any example. Could you kindly give me some suggestions please (like papers, presentations, programming code, etc)?
 
Thank you very much.
 
Best regards,
 
An
